facts.fact: Train tickets can be booked 60 days in advance, excluding the date of journey; the Advance Reservation Period was cut from 120 to 60 days with effect from 01.11.2024
facts.quote: Indian Railways has cut down Advance Reservation Period from current 120 days to 60 days w.e.f. 01.11.2024; excluding the date of the journey

facts.fact: The change was made by Railway Board Commercial Circular No. 10 of 2024 (Time limit for Advance Reservations), dated 16.10.2024
facts.quote: CC-10 Time limit for Advance Reservations. 16.10.2024

facts.fact: Bookings already made under the 120-day ARP before the change remain valid
facts.quote: All existing Bookings made under the 120-day ARP prior to October 31, 2024, will remain valid.

facts.fact: Certain day-time express trains such as the Taj Express and Gomti Express keep their lower advance reservation limits
facts.quote: Certain daytime express trains like the Taj Express and Gomti Express will continue to follow the lower time limits for advance reservations.

facts.fact: The 365-day advance reservation limit for foreign tourists is unchanged
facts.quote: The 365-day ARP limit for foreign tourists remains unchanged.

facts.fact: On the opening day of ARP booking, reserved general tickets on the IRCTC website/app can be booked only by Aadhaar-authenticated users (Lok Sabha reply, PIB 25.03.2026)
facts.quote: During the opening day of general reservation of ARP, the reserved general tickets can be booked through the website of IRCTC or its app only by Aadhar authenticated users.

facts.fact: This began under Commercial Circular No. 15 of 2025 (dated 15.09.2025) as an Aadhaar-only rule for the first 15 minutes of opening of general reservation on IRCTC, from 01.10.2025
facts.quote: it has been decided that with effect from 01.10.2025, during the first 15 minutes of opening of general reservation, reserved general tickets can be booked through the website of Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC)/its app only by Aadhaar authenticated users.

facts.fact: Booking timings at computerised PRS counters are unchanged
facts.quote: There shall, however, be no change in the timings of booking of general reserved tickets through computerized PRS counters of Indian Railways at present.

summary: All facts confirmed: 60-day ARP excluding journey date from 01.11.2024 (PIB 17.10.2024; CC 10/2024 listed 16.10.2024), exceptions, and opening-day Aadhaar rule (PIB 25.03.2026, CC 15/2025). Old railwayboard URLs on indianrailways.gov.in now 404; the old site lives at ir.indianrailways.gov.in.
